hypotheses.root_cause: Junction temperature exceeded the thermal trip threshold: A sustained power burst outruns the cooling headroom
hypotheses.rationale: Temperature climbed past the DVFS policy and crossed the 105C trip point before throttling could recover it, triggering an emergency shutdown — a cooling-solution or fan-profile shortfall under sustained workload. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'power burst detected', 'p_w=' for RC_WORKLOAD_BURST. 1 of 3 similar historical incidents (runs 000020) were resolved as RC_WORKLOAD_BURST.
recommended_actions: Cap the burst power or lengthen the DVFS step-down reaction
Add thermal headroom to the test's power envelope
Inspect heatsink mounting/TIM and airflow on the DUT
Make the fan/DVFS profile more aggressive ahead of the trip point
